blocks.goal: Extract the configuration and attribute/protocol validation responsibility from Safelist into a new class (SafelistConfig) to reduce the number of public methods on Safelist and concentrate related fields and helpers.

expected_impact.rationale: A cohesive responsibility (managing allowed tags, attributes, enforced attributes, protocols, and relative-link setting + validation helpers) is moved to SafelistConfig. This removes ~13 public methods from Safelist (addTags, removeTags, addAttributes, removeAttributes, addEnforcedAttribute, removeEnforcedAttribute, preserveRelativeLinks setter and getter, addProtocols, removeProtocols, isSafeTag, isSafeAttribute, getEnforcedAttributes) plus related private helpers (getProtocolValue, isSafeProtocol, shouldAbsUrl) — significantly reducing Safelist's public method count and overall LOC.

ops.details: Create a new class org.jsoup.safety.SafelistConfig in the same package that encapsulates the Safelist configuration and validation responsibility. SafelistConfig will own the collections and flags: Set<TagName> tagNames, Map<TagName, Set<AttributeKey>> attributes, Map<TagName, Map<AttributeKey, AttributeValue>> enforcedAttributes, Map<TagName, Map<AttributeKey, Set<Protocol>>> protocols, and boolean preserveRelativeLinks. It will provide methods for configuring and validating: addTags, removeTags, addAttributes, removeAttributes, addEnforcedAttribute, removeEnforcedAttribute, preserveRelativeLinks (setter), preserveRelativeLinks() (getter), addProtocols, removeProtocols, isSafeTag, isSafeAttribute, getEnforcedAttributes, shouldAbsUrl. The helper/private methods supporting validation (getProtocolValue, isSafeProtocol) will be implemented as private methods inside SafelistConfig. Safelist.TagName, Safelist.AttributeKey, Safelist.AttributeValue, Safelist.Protocol and TypedValue remain as nested types in Safelist and are referenced from SafelistConfig as Safelist.TagName etc. Safelist will be updated to hold a private final SafelistConfig config field. Factory helper methods (none, basic, etc.) will be adjusted to configure the new Safelist instance by calling config methods internally (e.g., s.config.addTags(...)) rather than calling the moved methods on Safelist. The Safelist public API methods moved will be removed from Safelist (no compatibility delegating wrappers will be kept). Safelist's constructors will initialize the config; the copy constructor will deep-copy via a new SafelistConfig(SafelistConfig) constructor. This extraction groups a cohesive responsibility and reduces public methods on Safelist.

Move the configuration/state fields that represent allowed tags, attributes, enforced attributes, protocols, and preserveRelativeLinks flag into the new SafelistConfig class so the configuration/validation responsibility is self-contained.

ops.details: Move the public configuration and validation methods into SafelistConfig. Method implementations will be adapted to operate on the fields now owned by SafelistConfig. Each method will return SafelistConfig for fluent chaining where appropriate. The Safelist factory methods (none, basic, etc.) will be updated to call these config methods on the instance's config field internally.

Move private helper methods that implement protocol detection, anchor validation, and absolute-URL decision logic into SafelistConfig so they are co-located with the data they operate on. The package-private shouldAbsUrl(String, String) remains available from SafelistConfig for callers to use.

Add necessary imports to SafelistConfig (org.jsoup.nodes.Element, org.jsoup.nodes.Attribute, org.jsoup.nodes.Attributes, java.util.* and org.jsoup.internal.Normalizer if needed). Update Safelist imports to remove now-unused imports where appropriate.

Update internal call sites in Safelist (factory methods like basic(), basicWithImages(), relaxed(), simpleText(), none()) to configure the new instance through its private config field instead of calling fluent configuration methods on Safelist (e.g., replace chain calls with s.config.addTags(...); s.config.addAttributes(...); ...; return s;). Update the copy constructor to call new SafelistConfig(copy.config) to deep copy configuration state.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
